scenes.title: Three Days Left
scenes.summary: Sunday morning in the café corner: Chiara and Giulia calm Cesare down and divide the tasks needed before Wednesday at three.

scenes.title: The Green Guest Book
scenes.summary: Chiara, Lucia, and Cesare turn to May thirty years ago in the green guest book and learn why the Friday concert stopped.

scenes.title: Inside the Piano Action
scenes.summary: Bruno opens the front panel of the upright piano with Lucia and Davide and spots a slipped brass hinge pin on middle D.

scenes.title: Soap, Buckets, and Sunlight
scenes.summary: Chiara, Davide, and Paolo wash thirty years of dust off the tall arched sunroom glass with warm soapy water.

scenes.title: Stuck Shutters Outside
scenes.summary: Outside in the courtyard, Bruno, Chiara, and Cesare oil the rusty hinges on Room 9's exterior wooden shutters and swing them wide open.

scenes.title: Sixteen Missing Bars
scenes.summary: At dusk on Sunday, Lucia hums and pencils two possible endings for the waltz while Chiara and Davide listen over hot mint tea.

scenes.title: Testing the Café Menu
scenes.summary: In the kitchen corner, Giulia asks brothers Davide and Paolo to taste two versions of her Wednesday café soup and lemon tart.

scenes.title: Thunder at Midnight
scenes.summary: While closing up on Sunday night, Chiara and Bruno hear sudden thunder and rush to pull the newly sanded shutters under cover before a downpour.
